subject_line: An Author Spotlight for House of Gilded Nightmares
email_body:
Hi Aurora,

I came across your fantasy and paranormal romance work, including the City of Night and Raven Society series, and the way you write about magic, swoonworthy heroes and the strong women who fall for them stood out to me, especially knowing you write from Florida.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short cinematic trailer or a few promotional reels for House of Gilded Nightmares is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It would be an optional add-on, separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit House of Gilded Nightmares best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
